description: Create a warehouse (name + unique code required; type defaults to internal). Runs the canonical creation path: duplicate-name/code check, a default receiving location, and a companion store (same name as the warehouse, returned in stores[] with its own storeId — that storeId, never the warehouse id, is what sales-order import surfaces take). Pass customFields to set tenant-defined custom field values (see list_custom_fields with entity=warehouse); an unknown fieldName fails the call. Use for multi-warehouse tenants during onboarding — single-warehouse tenants already have Main from signup. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

code.description: Short warehouse code (required, unique per tenant, e.g. 'EAST').

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by fieldName (see list_custom_fields, entity=warehouse). list fields take an option id or name; multilist an array of them. An unknown fieldName fails the call.

name.description: Warehouse display name (required, unique per tenant).

type.description: internal (Spark-managed stock, default) or external (observed-only, e.g. a 3PL/marketplace node).

name: create_warehouse
title: Create Warehouse
